summary: This note is a short biographical entry on Prince Alexander Golitzen (also spelled Golitsyn), a Russian-born American production designer. It gives his birth in Moscow on February 28, 1908, his death in San Diego on July 26, 2005, and states that he oversaw art direction on more than 300 movies.
one_line: Russian-born American production designer Alexander Golitzen, who oversaw art direction on more than 300 movies.
key_facts: Prince Alexander Golitzen is also spelled Golitsyn in the note.
Alexander Golitzen was born in Moscow on February 28, 1908.
Alexander Golitzen died in San Diego on July 26, 2005.

Alexander Golitzen oversaw art direction on more than 300 movies.
